message: overflow-wrap isn't supported in Gmail Desktop Webmail, Gmail iOS, Gmail Android, Outlook Windows, Outlook.com, Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android; partly in Gmail Mobile Webmail, Apple Mail macOS, Apple Mail iOS
hint: Buggy. Requires `word-break:normal` to reset Apple Mail default style (See [issue#394](https://github.com/hteumeuleu/caniemail/issues/394).)

message: padding-top: 5% is not supported, use px
hint: Use px (em/rem are resolved). vw and vh are not supported, % only works for widths, and calc() only as calc(P% ± Npx) on a flex item.
